mappings.assertion: Resolved C5 function: recordMergeCompletion in internal/ops/merge_finalize.go, called by mergeInvocation.commitMerged inside the final MERGED transaction. TestC5MergeTimestampsAreUTCInMemory invokes it on an in-memory task between two UTC clock reads and asserts the appended completion handoff Timestamp.Location() and the merged history Time.Location() are time.UTC, each within the reads; it failed on the pre-C5 code (both locations reported not UTC) on this host and passes after the change.

TestC5MergeTimestampsPersistWithZUnderNonUTCZone re-runs the test binary as a child process with an explicitly built environment (TZ=Etc/GMT-2), requires child exit 0 and the child's PASS line, asserts the child's local offset is non-zero, runs a real MergeWorktree and asserts the merged task's raw completion handoff timestamp and merged history time end in Z, the seeded +02:00 task's two raw scalars are byte-identical, and a fresh read returns the seeded instants; it failed on the pre-C5 code (+02:00 persisted) and passes after. On Windows, where Go ignores TZ, the test skips and the in-memory test carries the zone proof.
TestC5LocalOffsetMergeTimestampsLoadAndSurviveWrites/live asserts the raw state.yaml holds both +02:00 scalars, Read returns equal instants, statevalidate.ValidateStateFile returns nil.

TestC5LocalOffsetMergeTimestampsLoadAndSurviveWrites/archived archives the task with EnableAndArchiveTerminalTasks, asserts the archive object's value_yaml holds both +02:00 scalars, Read restores the task with TerminalArchive set and equal instants, and validation returns nil.

Both subtests of TestC5LocalOffsetMergeTimestampsLoadAndSurviveWrites register an unrelated agent through a later state write and assert the raw live scalars, and for the archived task the stub's archive digest and the object's offset scalars, are unchanged; TestC5MergeTimestampsPersistWithZUnderNonUTCZone adds the live case through the merge write itself.

The test target (go test ./...) runs the ops, oracle and archguard suites with the C5 tests at index 1, including live TestOracleWtMerge/success, whose state golden pinned both C5 values as <TIME:+02:00> under the oracle driver's TZ=Etc/GMT-2 and now pins <TIME:Z> (the only golden delta: handoff_events completion timestamp and merged history time); the focused C5 race run at index 0, lint at index 2, test-e2e at index 3 and the ops race run at index 4 are mandatory with it.
